content.title: About
content.content: Kibby is a fragrant blend of dried fruits, nuts, and spices inspired by traditional Puerto Rican sweets. It combines the sweetness of mango, pineapple and coconut with a subtle hint of cinnamon and clove, creating a bright and rich flavor profile.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The Kibby recipe is based on generations‑old Puerto Rican family traditions.
Dried mango, considered the "golden fruit" in Puerto Rico for its color and taste, is a key ingredient.
Kibby is traditionally sold in small portion packets for holidays and family gatherings.
The mix of nuts and spices makes it a natural source of quick energy for active people.
Kibby contains no artificial colors or flavorings.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: The dried fruits and nuts provide vitamin B6 and niacin, which support energy metabolism.

items.title: Source of healthy fats
items.content: Nuts supply monounsaturated fats that are beneficial for heart health.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber from the dried fruits aids digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Coconut and spices such as cinnamon and clove are rich in antioxidants that help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamin C from dried pineapple boosts the immune system.

items.title: Tree nut allergy
items.content: The product contains nuts, which may trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: High natural sugar
items.content: Dried fruits are naturally sweet, so people monitoring blood sugar should consume Kibby in moderation.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: The blend is calorie‑dense; portion control is recommended, especially on weight‑management diets.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some versions may contain a small amount of salt for flavor; those with hypertension should check the label.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy Kibby as a snack on its own, stir it into yogurt, oatmeal, smoothies, or use it in baked goods. For a softer texture, soak the dried fruits in warm water for 10‑15 minutes before eating.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store Kibby in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For longer shelf life, keep the package in the refrigerator to preserve flavor and prevent the nuts from going rancid.
